How does this policy vary from country to country?
Spotlight Takeover
Australia
Alcohol advertisers targeting Australia are permitted to use Spotlight Takeover, subject to restrictions, and are only allowed with prior authorization from >x<.
Brazil
Alcohol advertisers targeting Brazil are permitted to use Spotlight Takeover, subject to restrictions, as long as alcoholic beverages promoted in the product have a strength less than 13%.
Japan
Gambling advertisers targeting Japan are permitted to use Spotlight Takeover, subject to restrictions.
Prior authorization from >x< is required.
Mexico
Gambling advertisers are permitted to use this product, so long as they comply with the
Alcohol advertisers targeting Mexico are permitted to use this product so long as they agree to our terms and conditions.
U.S.
Daily Fantasy Sports advertisers are permitted to utilise Spotlight Takeover subject to the following restrictions:
Disclaimers about age and state eligibility requirements are required
Information on gambling addiction hotline is required
No minors should be depicted
No unfair or misleading representations of winning
Sports Betting advertisers are permitted to utilise Spotlight Takeover subject to the following restrictions
No ability to place a bet in ad or on the landing page
No minors should be depicted
No unfair or misleading representations of winning
Disclaimers stating that sports betting is not legal in states where prohibited must be present
